title.zh: DeepSeek Harness日活突破154万，日消耗Token约92万亿
title.en: DeepSeek Harness日活突破154万，日消耗Token约92万亿

current_state.zh: DeepSeek disclosed that its Harness agent tool has reached 1.54 million daily active API users consuming roughly 92 trillion tokens per day, with ~35,000 community plugins, and said it will launch an official plugin marketplace and a developer token incentive program.
